svg.text: SHE ASKS ABOUT FALLS. THE ANSWER IS:
Every other AI scribe ticks the box. It was mentioned, never answered.
still missing: the number of falls,
and the circumstances of the last one
— an agent that catches it in the room, not that evening at your desk
Gemini 3.6 Flash on Vertex AI · Google ADK 2.6.2 · Cloud Run · Firestore
